A '''group''' of [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw]]-[[Technician/Legends|techs]] operated in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] around [[92 BBY/Legends|92 BBY]]. They established the [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. [[Bequesh]] was a member of the group, and was the last survivor who, as of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], served as ''[[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|Tanquilla Beach]]{{'s}} administrator.
